title: Export existing resources to ARM/Bicep
description: Exports running infrastructure to IaC templates for adopting infrastructure-as-code on existing environments.
example_prompt: "Export resource group '{rg_name}' to {Bicep/ARM}. Clean up the export: (1) remove read-only and auto-generated properties, (2) parameterize names, SKUs, and locations, (3) add missing dependencies between resources, (4) organize into modules by resource type. Generate the parameter file with current values."
